title: Sperner's Lemma: SimplicialComplex to Exists-Panchromatic Bridge
description: Bridges Mathlib's Geometry.SimplicialComplex to Sperner's lemma: given a pure pseudomanifold simplicial complex, instantiates the abstract exists_panchromatic theorem. 26 theorems, 0 sorries, 0 axioms.

overview.historicalContext: Sperner's lemma is the combinatorial backbone of Brouwer's fixed-point theorem. This file provides the concrete bridge from Mathlib's standard simplicial complex structures.
overview.problemStatement: For a pure simplicial complex with pseudomanifold property, prove existence of a panchromatic (fully-colored) simplex under any Sperner coloring.
overview.proofStrategy: Cells are subtypes of facets. Vertex ordering via Finset.sort. Adjacency via shared codimension-1 faces. Three adjacency axioms (adj_symm, adj_vertex, adj_ne) follow from pseudomanifold property.
keyInsights: **Direct hypothesis approach**: uses hypotheses matching SpernerMathlib.lean style rather than intermediate structures.
**Adjacency via erase**: for cell s at face position k, erase the k-th sorted vertex and find the adjacent cell sharing that face.
**Pseudomanifold axiom**: each codimension-1 face in exactly 1 or 2 top cells — gives well-defined adjacency.
